import sys,os,json,time
closefd = [sys.stdin.buffer.raw.closefd,sys.stdout.buffer.raw.closefd]
sys.stdin.close()
sys.stdout.close()
if sys.argv[1] == 'descriptors':
    os.close(0)
    os.close(1)
open_fds = []
for fd in (0,1):
    try: os.fstat(fd)
    except OSError: pass
    else: open_fds.append(fd)
print(json.dumps({'closefd':closefd,'open_fds':open_fds}),file=sys.stderr,flush=True)
time.sleep(0.3)
